Ends the policy layers: the output layer and the action distribution.

Adds the output layer sized from the environment: one logit per choice (categorical) for discrete actions, one mean per action (Gaussian, with one learned log standard deviation per action) for continuous ones. Its weights start orthogonal with gain 0.01, as Stable-Baselines3 does. Do not put a Softmax before it.
